summary: The AddNonvoter control ran (CheckRun 9245773442404356acaafba5198cba2a, exit 0) and validated the discriminator behind the AddVoter witness. With the harness held fixed and only the public join call changed, the added member came out as a Nonvoter with two voters in the configuration, and after one original voter was disconnected the next command did not commit - the future returned leadership lost after about 50 ms and the leader stepped down to Follower - while the added node still advanced its log. Against the witness, where the member was written as a Voter, three voters were present, and the same disconnect still left a committing majority, the pair shows the commit in the witness could only have come from the freshly added member's acknowledgement, so the earlier counterweight is answered rather than merely noted. I recorded the control observation as a fact and the suffrage-decides-commit contrast as a behaviour citing both receipts, and wrote the interpretation that closes that residual uncertainty while keeping the edges sharp: this is a documented-contract defect, because the implementation matches its own unit expectations, and no consensus-safety rule is broken since voters still compare logs before granting votes. I also opened one new sourced question for the remaining budget: raft.go marks processHeartbeat and appendEntries as main-thread-only, yet the network transport will dispatch a strictly empty AppendEntries request to that handler from its connection goroutine, and such a request still runs the term logic, so a heartbeat carrying a higher term can call setState and setCurrentTerm off the main thread. The question is recorded with the discovery that the in-memory transport no-ops SetHeartbeatHandler - so this path is unreachable in every harness shape used so far - and with a discriminator that requires a transport implementing the fast path for real; I assert no defect claim on it yet, and the earlier witnessed findings on the configuration index, duties lost at shutdown, and the vote-less transfer all remain recorded and unaffected.
